viralPosts.text:
Just learned 'access fatigue' 🤯

meaning: the effects of constantly having to explain, teach, & reinvent access. This demand wears us down, shapes how we see ourselves, and makes pushing for inclusion harder. 

It IS exhausting. I'm so glad I have the vocabulary for this now.

#DisabilityJustice

viralPosts.text:
An icon button with a visible label doesn't need an aria-label on the icon. The icon should be treated as a decorative image using aria-hidden.

Both the aria-label on the icon and the visible lable would both be announced which is redundant and possibly confusing.

#A11y #FrontEnd
